purpose: Teach: パワフル/備わっ/チョイス/分量/健闘/切り離し/編著/有数

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、パワフルな発信力を磨け
lines.en: Ren — sharpen your ability to communicate your findings powerfully.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Leans slightly forward. The opening word carries expectation without harshness. Eyes steady. A mentor assessing capacity and inviting growth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者としての素養が備わってきました
lines.en: Yes. I'm developing the foundational skills I need as a researcher.
lines.style: Quiet, respectful. Slight nod on the opening. Genuine conviction underneath the formality — he means this. A pause before finishing, as if checking himself for accuracy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究テーマのチョイスは慎重にしろ
lines.en: Ren — choose your research topic with care. This matters.
lines.style: Slower tempo. The word 'care' lands with quiet weight. No rush. The tone of someone who has seen good researchers derailed by hasty choices.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データ分量を吟味いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll scrutinize the data thoroughly before committing to anything.
lines.style: Respectful precision. Each phrase considered. Not mechanical — there's warmth underneath — but he's being careful with his words in front of this man.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、学会での健闘を期待する
lines.en: Ren — I expect strong work from you at the conference.
lines.style: Brief, confident. A light tap of faith on 'strong.' No coddling. The kind of expectation that feels like belief rather than demand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。余分な仮説は研究から切り離します
lines.en: Yes. I'll remove any extraneous assumptions from my research design.
lines.style: Formal but not stiff. A small breath before 'extraneous' — he's choosing the right word carefully. Polite closure, but beneath it: determination.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文集の編著にも参加しろ
lines.en: Ren — I want you involved in editing that paper collection too.
lines.style: Natural authority. Not a question. Not unkind — a simple assignment that is also an opportunity. Eyes steady. This is what you're ready for.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当分野有数の研究者を目指します
lines.en: Yes. I'm going to become one of the leading researchers in this field.
lines.style: Clear, settled commitment. A small pause before 'leading' — not arrogance, but quiet certainty. The closing word trails slightly, like a door closing on an old self.
